Expected to be sidelined at least a month, which would put his return around mid-to-late September - likely missing the Sept. 13 opener at San Francisco and possibly Week 2 as well.

Hurt in the preseason game vs. the Rams; HC Kellen Moore confirmed Tuesday, Aug. 25 that Chandler will miss the entire season, and New Orleans placed him (along with TE Moliki Matavao) on season-ending injured reserve. Compounds a thin backfield with Alvin Kamara out (MCL) and Devin Neal dealing with a hamstring - the Saints traded for RB Zamir White this week in response.

Bresee tore his ACL in an early training-camp practice and was placed on injured reserve Aug. 7 ahead of surgery. He is out for 2026 and targeting full health for 2027; John Ridgeway is expected to start in his place.

Took a hit to the hip in an Aug. 17 scrimmage and was rested while it calmed down; HC Dan Campbell would not guarantee Week 1, saying "I feel like we'll be OK, but I don't know." LaPorta returned to practice Tuesday, Aug. 25, taking part in both individual and team drills - a strong sign for the Sept. 13 opener vs. New Orleans, though Detroit has not committed and is expected to stay cautious. He is separately fully cleared from November 2025 back surgery.

injury.type: Back injury (on top of an MCL sprain)
injury.note: HC Dan Campbell said Thursday that Pacheco is now dealing with a back injury and is uncertain for Week 1 - "I can't give you anything definitive." Campbell indicated the earlier MCL sprain is no longer the concern. Detroit worked out free-agent RB Kareem Hunt earlier in the week.

Suffered a season-ending torn ACL during Tuesday's joint practice with the Raiders, falling awkwardly on a red-zone route in 11-on-11 drills. The 2025 second-round pick started 10 games as a rookie (525 yards, 6 TDs); Houston will lean more on Xavier Hutchinson, Tank Dell and Jaylin Noel in his absence.
The Texans placed Horton (Achilles) on injured reserve Tuesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

Held out of practice in late August with what HC DeMeco Ryans called a lower leg injury - "We expect him back soon." Clowney re-signed with Houston in early August for a second stint with the team that drafted him No. 1 overall in 2014. No firm return date, but the team's public tone points to a short-term absence.

Diagnosis came back Thursday, Aug. 27: Adam Schefter reported Smith suffered an injury to his plantar fascia after being carted off Wednesday's joint practice with Carolina. He could miss "a few weeks" per a source, but it is not considered long-term. Trent Brown is expected to start at right tackle in his place, putting Smith's availability for the Sept. 13 opener in doubt. Smith signed a two-year, $25M deal in March after starting 105 of 107 games for the Colts from 2018-25.

injury.type: Left leg injury (no structural damage) - recovered
injury.note: Returned to full practice and 11-on-11 team drills Monday, Aug. 17, after missing most of the prior week following a leg injury suffered tangling feet with WR Ja'Kobi Lane. HC Jesse Minter called the return a positive sign; Wiggins is set to be available for joint practices with Minnesota later this week.

Returned to full practice and 11-on-11 team drills Monday, Aug. 17, after a groin issue sidelined him for several days. HC Jesse Minter said Humphrey bounced back well; on track for Baltimore's joint practices with Minnesota later this week.

Tore the patellar tendon during the Aug. 19 joint practice with the Vikings in Eagan, Minnesota, and was carted off in a full-leg brace. Baltimore placed him on injured reserve Wednesday, Aug. 26, ending his season. He had been taking most first-team center reps after Tyler Linderbaum's offseason move to the Raiders; Ethan Pocic and Jovaughn Gwyn are the leading options to replace him.

Left an Aug. 8 camp practice with a left quadriceps contusion and was listed day-to-day by HC Jesse Minter. Sat out Tuesday and Wednesday (Aug. 25-26) as a precaution, which Minter described as minor, then returned Thursday, Aug. 27 practicing without limitations. Expected to be ready for Baltimore's Week 1 opener.
questionable

Left Wednesday's joint practice vs. Atlanta clutching his groin and did not return; HC Shane Steichen confirmed the injury. Per NFL insider Jordan Schultz, the Colts avoided a critical injury — Warren is expected to be out roughly a week, not weeks — though he'll be shut down for the rest of camp/preseason as a precaution. Second-year first-round pick coming off a strong rookie season (76 catches, 817 yards, 5 total TDs) and expected to be a lead target for Daniel Jones; trending toward being ready for the regular season.

Activated off the active/PUP list Thursday, Aug. 27, clearing him to practice for the first time this camp after late-March ankle surgery (a PRP treatment had failed to resolve the pain). He worked out before Saturday's preseason game vs. Detroit but did not play, per Mike Chappell of Fox 59. He topped 1,000 receiving yards in 2025 and led the NFL in yards per catch for a second straight year; expected to be available for the Sept. 13 opener, though he still needs ramping up after missing all of camp.
Originally hurt in an October 2024 collision with Derrick Henry. Placed on reserve/PUP for a second straight season; not expected to play in 2026.
The Browns placed Wright on injured reserve Sunday due to a ruptured Achilles, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
ir

Recovering from Nov. 25, 2025 left-knee ACL surgery (his third career ACL procedure). Cleared Aug. 21 to return to 11-on-11 work but sat out Friday's preseason finale at Miami with only three full practices back. Atlanta's Week 1 depth chart lists Tua Tagovailoa as the starter and omits Penix as an "injured player"; per Ian Rapoport, Tagovailoa inherited the job rather than winning it outright while Penix is not fully cleared. Penix has said full medical clearance could still be a few weeks away, and both QBs are expected to play at some point in 2026.

Carted off during an 11-on-11 period at Tuesday's practice; an MRI later that evening confirmed a torn ACL, per The Athletic's Josh Kendall. The 2025 first-round pick (No. 15 overall) will miss the entire 2026 season.

Activated off the PUP list and returned to practice Monday, Aug. 24, alongside rookie OL Max Iheanachor (neck). HC Mike McCarthy called it a positive step after Ramsey opened camp on PUP with a minicamp knee injury (no surgery required); he's expected to be limited/ramping up gradually. Barring a setback, he's on track to be Pittsburgh's top slot corner for the Sept. 13 regular-season opener vs. Atlanta.

injury.type: Knee injury - reverted to injured reserve
injury.note: Carted off during a non-contact 7-on-7 period at an early padded camp practice. The Steelers waived him with an injury designation; he cleared waivers and reverted to Pittsburgh's injured reserve, likely ending his 2026 season. A 2024 UDFA out of the Bengals' practice squad, he was a depth/roster-bubble receiver - impact score lowered accordingly. Pittsburgh signed WR Jakobie Keeney-James in his place.
Jonathan (thigh) reverted to the Jets' injured reserve Wednesday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

Evaluated for a concussion after a hard hit from Bears S Xavier Woods in Thursday's joint practice - a hit HC Robert Saleh called "cheap." Ian Rapoport and follow-up reporting indicate Robinson is not believed to have suffered a concussion and is expected to avoid the protocol; Tennessee is still monitoring him in case symptoms develop.

Rookie first-round pick (No. 3 overall) hurt his ankle late in Arizona's preseason game vs. the Raiders. HC Mike LaFleur said Monday, Aug. 24 that Love is progressing but will be sidelined this week, ruling him out for the rest of the preseason. No long-term prognosis given; the team is still hopeful he's available for the Sept. 13 opener vs. the Chargers.
Weaver (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve by the Cardinals on Monday.

Returned to practice Saturday, Aug. 22 as a limited participant, per HC Jim Harbaugh - his first practice action since missing 8 straight sessions. Worked through individual drills and the first team-drill period before stepping aside; still considered day-to-day, but the return is a positive sign after a knee flare-up in his surgically repaired patellar tendon. No firm timetable yet for a return to full practice.

Officially placed on season-ending injured reserve Aug. 23 after tearing his ACL when a 49ers defensive lineman fell into his leg during an Aug. 18 joint practice. Signed with the Chargers in March on a 3-year, $30M deal after playing for Washington last season; Chargers will turn to their backup center options for the year.
Reverted to injured reserve Aug. 27 after clearing waivers with an injury designation, ending his 2026 season with Miami barring a settlement. The injury has not been disclosed.

injury.type: Ankle sprain (low-grade; believed more low than high)
injury.note: Helped off the practice field Sunday, Aug. 23 after landing awkwardly on a dive for a catch. Per Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter the sprain is believed to be "more low than high" and is not considered long-term, and Jeanty was back on the practice field Wednesday, Aug. 26. HC Klint Kubiak has since said Jeanty is "still on the mend" and that the Raiders need another week before they can assess his availability for the Sept. 13 opener vs. Miami. Rookie RB Mike Washington Jr. continues taking first-team reps.

Suffered a torn ACL plus meniscus repair in Week 15 last season vs. Denver. Opened camp on PUP (July 29) and is expected to start the regular season there too, which would force him to miss at least the first four games. On Aug. 10, Parsons told NFL Network his 'most optimistic' return is Week 6 (Oct. 18, SNF vs. his old team the Cowboys at Lambeau), but stressed there's no guarantee given the Packers' internal recovery protocol for ACL-plus injuries.

Sidelined from Aug. 6 before returning to practice Aug. 18 per HC Matt LaFleur; he was still limited in team periods as of Aug. 24. Green Bay has consistently described the groin as neither severe nor a long-term concern, and he is expected to be ready for the regular season. (An automated note previously attached here referenced an unrelated off-field legal matter rather than an injury and has been removed.)

New to Green Bay's camp injury report in early August with a sprained foot. Coach Matt LaFleur says he's hopeful Reed will be ready for the Sept. 7 season opener vs. Detroit, though the team is proceeding cautiously with the soft-tissue issue.
Returned to practice July 29 after a mild hamstring strain; fully participated with no limitations in Sunday's (Aug. 9) public training camp practice. On track for Week 1 vs. Chicago.

Adams went down without contact in coverage during the Aug. 15 preseason game at the Giants and was carted off. Testing confirmed a torn right quad tendon and Minnesota placed him on injured reserve Aug. 17, ending his season.

Hurt in a one-on-one pass-rush rep vs. Odafe Oweh during Saturday's practice; underwent surgery to repair the torn triceps. HC Dan Quinn didn't disclose an exact timeline, but recovery from this type of injury typically runs 4-7 months, likely sidelining him for most if not all of the 2026 season. Washington moved Brandon Coleman to left tackle in his place, with Andrew Wylie as depth; Quinn said the team isn't looking outside the building for additional O-line help.

Strained lifting weights ahead of camp; placed on PUP list on the first day of training camp. Traded to Philadelphia from Minnesota in April 2026 on a 4-year, $100M deal. DC Vic Fangio said Aug. 11 that Greenard is expected to miss at least a 'couple more weeks,' pushing him past all of training camp, though the injury is still not considered a long-term concern.

Back at practice this week in a limited/individual-drills capacity as the Eagles ramp him up ahead of joint sessions with New England; team says the hamstring issue is not serious and there's no long-term concern, though a firm return-to-full timetable still hasn't been set.
Wilson (knee) reverted to Philadelphia's injured reserve Saturday, per the NFL's transaction log.

Recovering from the torn right ACL and meniscus damage suffered in September 2025. Shed the red non-contact jersey for the first time on Aug. 25 and took reps in both 7-on-7 and 11-on-11, catching passes in each. HC John Harbaugh said it is "reasonable to assume" Nabers plays in the Sept. 13 opener vs. Dallas but has not committed either way; the remaining step is live contact work.

Carted off Tuesday's (Aug. 25) practice after his knee buckled running a route; Adam Schefter initially reported a "serious knee injury" and a source confirmed to ESPN on Wednesday, Aug. 26 that it is a torn ACL that will cost him the 2026 season. Austin, 27 and in a contract year, had been in line for a significant role in New York's passing game - a bigger blow with Malik Nabers still working back from his own ACL tear.

Suffered the injury Dec. 14, 2025 vs. the Chargers, ending his 2025 season; had knee debridement surgery in May. Fully cleared off the PUP list for camp and has been a full practice participant, including 11-on-11 team drills, since late July. Ian Rapoport reports he is on track to start Week 1 against Denver, and Mahomes said in late August that he "feels great."
